Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Description: Prepares one tech's route for the offline file to download.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Called over OData by Import Route with { account }. Returns RouteExports keys,

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: never the data itself -- an OData script result holds only ~1 MB.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Generated by scripts/generate-build-route-export.js -- edit that, not this.

Value.Calculation: Let ( a = JSONGetElement ( Get ( ScriptParameter ) ; "account" ) ; If ( Left ( a ; 1 ) = "?" ; "" ; a ) )

Step.name: Exit Script
Step.Calculation: JSONSetElement ( "{}" ; [ "error" ; "No account was given." ; JSONString ] ; [ "totalMs" ; ( Get ( CurrentTimeUTCMilliseconds ) - $t0 ) ; JSONNumber ] )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ----------THE ACCOUNT'S CUSTOMERS---------- #

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Users and Customers are small tables; ExecuteSQL is fine here.

Value.Calculation: Let ( [ a = Filter ( ExecuteSQL ( "select \"CustomersAssigned\" from \"USERS\" where \"Account_Name\" = ?" ; "" ; "" ; $account ) ; "0123456789," ) ; b = Substitute ( "," & a & "," ; [ ",,," ; "," ] ; [ ",," ; "," ] ) ] ; Middle ( b ; 2 ; Length ( b ) - 2 ) )

Step.name: Exit Script
Step.Calculation: JSONSetElement ( "{}" ; [ "error" ; "No customers are assigned to the account " & $account & ". Ask the office to assign your route before downloading." ; JSONString ] ; [ "totalMs" ; ( Get ( CurrentTimeUTCMilliseconds ) - $t0 ) ; JSONNumber ] )

Value.Calculation: Let ( p = Position ( $row ; Char ( 9 ) ; 1 ; 1 ) ; JSONSetElement ( $customers ; "[" & ( $c - 1 ) & "]" ; JSONSetElement ( "{}" ; [ "__kp_Customer" ; Left ( $row ; p - 1 ) ; JSONNumber ] ; [ "Customer_Name" ; Middle ( $row ; p + 1 ; Length ( $row ) ) ; JSONString ] ) ; JSONObject ) )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ----------CLEAR THIS ACCOUNT'S EARLIER EXPORTS---------- #

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Left behind when a download was interrupted. Delete only on a successful find:

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: after a failed one the found set is whatever it was, possibly everything.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ----------LOCATIONS: ACTIVE, ONE REQUEST PER CUSTOMER---------- #

Step.name: Exit Script
Step.Calculation: JSONSetElement ( "{}" ; [ "error" ; If ( $locError = 401 ; "No active locations for the customers assigned to " & $account & "." ; "Could not find the locations for " & $account & " (error " & $locError & ")." ) ; JSONString ] ; [ "totalMs" ; ( Get ( CurrentTimeUTCMilliseconds ) - $t0 ) ; JSONNumber ] )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Keys for the finds below, read without leaving the found set.

Value.Calculation: List ( $addrIDs ; GetNthRecord ( customers__LOCATIONS::AddressBill_ID ; $r ) ; GetNthRecord ( customers__LOCATIONS::AddressPhysical_ID ; $r ) ; GetNthRecord ( customers__LOCATIONS::AddressShip_ID ; $r ) )

Step.name: Exit Script
Step.Calculation: JSONSetElement ( "{}" ; [ "error" ; "Could not prepare locations for " & $account & " (export " & $exportError & If ( PatternCount ( GetAsText ( $file ) ; "[MBS]" ) ; ", " & GetAsText ( $file ) ; "" ) & ")." ; JSONString ] ; [ "totalMs" ; ( Get ( CurrentTimeUTCMilliseconds ) - $t0 ) ; JSONNumber ] )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ----------EQUIPMENT: RELATED TO THOSE LOCATIONS---------- #

Step.name: Exit Script
Step.Calculation: JSONSetElement ( "{}" ; [ "error" ; "The route for " & $account & " is too large to prepare in one go (stopped before equipment after " & Round ( ( Get ( CurrentTimeUTCMilliseconds ) - $t0 ) / 1000 ; 0 ) & " s). Ask the office." ; JSONString ] ; [ "totalMs" ; ( Get ( CurrentTimeUTCMilliseconds ) - $t0 ) ; JSONNumber ] )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: 101 = no related records: a route with no equipment yet is fine.

Step.name: Exit Script
Step.Calculation: JSONSetElement ( "{}" ; [ "error" ; "Could not find the equipment for " & $account & " (error " & $eqError & ")." ; JSONString ] ; [ "totalMs" ; ( Get ( CurrentTimeUTCMilliseconds ) - $t0 ) ; JSONNumber ] )

Step.name: If
Step.Calculation: $eqError = 0 and Get ( LayoutTableName ) = "customers_locations__CUSTOMERS_EQUIPMENT" and Get ( FoundCount ) > 0
